description: Existing Bike Network is a series of datasets listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Boston Maps. This dataset contains an inventory of existing bicycle facilities within the City of Boston. It is intended for information purposes only. It is not intended to aid in trip routing. Actual conditions may vary from what is indicated in the dataset due to construction or other reasons. Updated by BTD in June 2022. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Boston Maps. Its tags are 2022, BTD, Bike Network, static. It offers 8 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2024-12-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
